_note: 英語島文法分區 sidecar：一檔一單元一 KP。unit_id＝KP id＝eng.t_adv.pattern.sv-agreement（主詞動詞一致，t_adv 學測級）。鐵律：單數主詞配單數動詞（現在式第三人稱單數加 -s）、複數主詞配原形；a/an＋單數名詞為單數；主詞與動詞之間的介系詞片語（of apples、in my class）不改變主詞的單複數，動詞仍與真正的主詞（中心名詞）一致——The box of apples IS heavy；each／every＋單數名詞視為單數（each of＋複數名詞仍為單數：Each of the boys has）。MCQ 每題唯一可辯護正解＋distractor_rationales＋answer_evidence。R14：teach body 全英文、中文放 zh_hint。以 Swan/Cambridge/Oxford 查證、status provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。含純文字 shadowing（無音檔）。

units.title_zh: 主詞動詞一致（單複數／介系詞片語不影響／each·every）
units.can_do: 我能讓動詞和真正的主詞在單複數上一致：單數主詞配單數動詞、複數主詞配原形；看穿介系詞片語（of…、in…）不改變主詞的數；each／every＋單數名詞用單數動詞。
units.situation_group: 句型：主詞動詞一致 Subject-verb agreement
units.subject: eng

claims.text: A singular subject takes a singular verb and a plural subject takes a plural verb. In the present simple, the third-person singular verb adds -s/-es: 'The dog runs.' / 'The dogs run.'
claims.verification_ref: 單數主詞配單數動詞、複數主詞配原形；現在式第三人稱單數加 -s/-es（The dog runs / The dogs run）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A singular countable noun with 'a' or 'an' is singular, so it takes a singular verb: 'A good dictionary helps students.'
claims.verification_ref: a/an＋單數可數名詞為單數，用單數動詞（A good dictionary helps…）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: A prepositional phrase (such as 'of apples' or 'in my class') between the subject and the verb does not change the subject's number. The verb agrees with the real subject (the head noun): 'The box of apples is heavy.' (subject = box)
claims.verification_ref: 主詞與動詞間的介系詞片語（of apples / in my class）不改變主詞單複數，動詞與中心名詞一致（The box of apples IS heavy，主詞＝box）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'each' and 'every' with a singular noun are treated as singular and take a singular verb. 'each of' + a plural noun is also singular: 'Each student has a book.' / 'Every room is clean.' / 'Each of the boys has a ticket.'
claims.verification_ref: each／every＋單數名詞視為單數、用單數動詞；each of＋複數名詞仍為單數（Each student has / Every room is / Each of the boys has）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: The verb must agree with its subject in number. A singular subject takes a singular verb; a plural subject takes a plural verb. In the present simple, a third-person singular subject (he, she, it, or a singular noun) adds -s to the verb.
teach.zh_hint: 動詞要和主詞在『單複數』上一致：單數主詞配單數動詞、複數主詞配原形動詞。現在簡單式中，第三人稱單數主詞（he、she、it 或單數名詞）後面的動詞要加 -s。

teach.body: The dog runs fast. / The dogs run fast. / A good dictionary helps students learn.
teach.zh_hint: The dog runs fast.（單數主詞→runs）The dogs run fast.（複數主詞→run）A good dictionary helps students learn.（a＋單數名詞→helps）

teach.body: Watch out for a prepositional phrase (such as 'of apples' or 'in my class') sitting between the subject and the verb. It does not change the subject's number. Find the real subject (the head noun) and make the verb agree with it, not with the noun inside the phrase.
teach.zh_hint: 小心主詞和動詞之間的介系詞片語（例如 of apples、in my class）：它不會改變主詞的單複數。要找出真正的主詞（中心名詞），讓動詞跟它一致，而不是跟片語裡的名詞一致。

teach.body: The box of apples is heavy. (subject = box, singular) / The students in my class study hard. (subject = students, plural)
teach.zh_hint: The box of apples is heavy.（真正主詞是 box，單數→is；of apples 只是修飾）The students in my class study hard.（真正主詞是 students，複數→study；in my class 只是修飾）

teach.body: 'each' and 'every' with a singular noun are treated as singular, so they take a singular verb. 'each of' before a plural noun is still singular. Note: 'every' is not used with 'of' (we do not say 'every of the').
teach.zh_hint: each 和 every ＋單數名詞視為單數，動詞用單數形；each of ＋複數名詞也還是單數。注意：every 不接 of（沒有 every of the 這種說法）。

teach.body: Each student has a locker. / Every room is clean. / Each of the boys has a ticket.
teach.zh_hint: Each student has a locker.（each＋單數→has）Every room is clean.（every＋單數→is）Each of the boys has a ticket.（each of＋複數名詞仍為單數→has）

practice.stem: 填入正確：My sister ____ to school every day.（我妹妹每天走路上學）

distractor_rationales.walk: 主詞 My sister 是第三人稱單數，現在簡單式動詞要加 -s → walks。
distractor_rationales.are walking: are 是複數 be 動詞，主詞 My sister 是單數，不能用 are；此處表每天的習慣，用 walks。
distractor_rationales.walking: 單獨 walking 不能當主要動詞，前面需要 be 動詞。

practice.feedback: 主詞單數 My sister ＋ every day（習慣）→ 現在簡單式第三人稱單數 walks。

practice.stem: 填入正確：The box of apples ____ very heavy.（這箱蘋果很重）

distractor_rationales.are: 真正的主詞是 box（單數），of apples 只是修飾片語、不改變主詞的單複數，故用 is 不用 are。
distractor_rationales.were: were 是複數過去式；主詞 box 單數且句意為現在，用 is。
distractor_rationales.being: being 不能單獨當主要動詞。

practice.feedback: 主詞是 box（單數），of apples 不影響主詞數 → The box of apples is very heavy。

practice.stem: 填入正確：Each student ____ a locker in the hallway.（每個學生都有一個置物櫃）

distractor_rationales.have: each ＋單數名詞 student 視為單數，動詞用 has，不用 have。
distractor_rationales.having: 單獨 having 不能當主要動詞。
distractor_rationales.are having: are 是複數；且 have 表『擁有』是狀態動詞，一般不用進行式；each student 為單數用 has。

practice.feedback: Each ＋單數名詞 student → 單數動詞 has：Each student has a locker。

practice.stem: 填入正確：The students in my class ____ hard for the exam.（我班上的學生為考試用功讀書）

distractor_rationales.studies: studies 是第三人稱單數形；真正主詞 The students 是複數，用原形 study。
distractor_rationales.is studying: is 是單數；主詞 students 是複數，而 in my class 不改變主詞數，用 study。
distractor_rationales.was studying: was 是單數過去式；主詞複數且句意為現在，用 study。

practice.feedback: 真正主詞是 students（複數），in my class 不影響 → 複數動詞 study。

practice.stem: 填入正確：Every seat in the theater ____ taken before the show started.（開演前戲院裡每個座位都坐滿了）

distractor_rationales.were: every ＋單數名詞 seat 視為單數，用 was 不用 were；in the theater 不改變主詞數。
distractor_rationales.are: 句意為過去（before the show started），且 every seat 為單數，用 was。
distractor_rationales.have been: 主詞單數不會用 have been（要 has been）；此處為過去，用 was。

practice.feedback: Every ＋單數名詞 seat → 單數；過去時間 → was：Every seat … was taken。

practice.stem: 選出主詞動詞一致正確的句子：
practice.answer: A good dictionary helps students learn new words.
options: A good dictionary helps students learn new words.
A good dictionary help students learn new words.
The teachers in this school is kind.
Each of the girls have a pen.

distractor_rationales.A good dictionary help students learn ne: 主詞 A good dictionary 是單數，動詞要加 -s → helps。
主詞 teachers 是複數（in this school 不改變主詞數），要用 are。
each of ＋複數名詞仍視為單數，動詞用 has，不是 have。

practice.feedback: A good dictionary（a＋單數名詞）→ helps，主詞動詞一致正確。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀出每句，一邊讀一邊指出『真正的主詞是誰』、動詞是否跟它一致；介系詞片語只是插在中間的修飾。

lines.text: The box of apples is on the table.
lines.intonation: box 與 is 稍強調（提醒主詞是 box）、句尾下收

lines.text: Each of the students has a schoolbag.
lines.intonation: Each 與 has 稍強調、句尾下收
